messages.subject: RE: Project Indigo - Licence Agreement (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Our mark-up attached (tracked). The main moves: running royalty down to 4.0%; liability cap up to 150% of trailing-12-month fees; and the post-termination sell-off period extended from six to nine months. We're comfortable on most of the boilerplate.

Amelia

messages.plaintextBody:
James - their v2 is in. 4.0% royalty is below our 6% but above the 4.5% Eleanor said she'd accept; 150% cap is fine; nine-month sell-off is fine. Suggest we counter at 4.5% and accept the cap and sell-off. I'll prepare v3.

Elena

Best wishes,
Elena

Whitfield Carter LLP
